title: Seth Ryan out to ‘replicate’ excitement around Jets from dad Rex’s days — but with own coaching twist

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Seth Ryan out to ‘replicate’ excitement around Jets from dad Rex’s days — but with own coaching twist
sources.description: Unlike his father and grandfather, who were defensive geniuses, the younger Ryan, Seth, has been an offensive coach since he got his start in the NFL.
